finding: query_paths.spans says missing capture has length0/offset0, while the accepted pre-code unobserved-query fragments retain the API-specific declared reserved span with QUERY_SPAN_PRESENT=true and QUERY_CAPTURE_OBSERVED=false. No subject has executed; this conflict was found by static source review.
decision: Preserve the existing wire literals and their expectations. Per-call span fields identify declared reserved ownership of the applicable file/API query frame. Span presence is independent of whether bytes were observed from that API. Applicable reserved spans may therefore retain exact offsets/lengths before or without capture. APIs without a query frame retain zero offset/length and false span presence.
observation_rule: QUERY_CAPTURE_OBSERVED and QUERY_DEFINED remain separate actual observations. A zero-filled reserved pool region with capture false is unobserved storage, never evidence of an observed all-zero frame. No identity, path, size, attributes or parser conclusion may be derived from it. Decode and source consumers must respect these flags.
erratum_scope: This explicitly corrects only the missing-capture length/offset wording in the preserved b71 schema; it changes no bytes, semantic fixtures, negative classifications, enum/layout, capacity or authority. Do not rewrite b71 or its earlier evidence. Captured query facts must still use their actual immutable observed bytes, not a later mutable reader.
